cars.specification_market: Early Morgan Plus 8 factory handbook hosted by GoMoG, scanned PDF pages 6–9. Power and torque are explicitly gross, not modern net values. This early 3.5-litre reference preserves the original mechanical character, including sliding-pillar front suspension and a four-speed gearbox.

cars.summary: The MGB is an enduring British sports-car icon, with a roadster lineage spanning 1962–1980. The original open car combined all-steel monocoque construction, an enlarged pushrod four-cylinder engine and accessible two-seat sports-car packaging in a form that became central to MG’s identity.
